lore: The islands pay each other in save credits, corked in bottles and thrown into the sea lanes. Harbourmaster Tilde must tally every credit on the archipelago, but she cannot stop the tide. Count by each island's own glass and some bottles are counted twice or not at all; ring one bell for everyone and the bottles at sea are missed. Throw a marked bottle down every lane, and the lanes themselves tell you what was still afloat.

lines.start: Every credit on the archipelago, counted while the bottles keep sailing.
lines.marker: A marked bottle. Count your hold now and pass the mark down every lane.
lines.lane: This bottle beat the mark down its lane. It counts as at sea.
lines.win: Every credit counted once, and not a bottle stopped.
lines.fail: The tally is off. Some bottles were counted twice or never. Send the marks.
